audit_items.proof_trace: Authorization tuple signatures lack range validation. Transaction signatures validate r∈(0,n-1) and s∈(0,n) via BaseSignatureTxValidator::L335-336, but AuthorizationListTxValidator::L372-377 only checks list non-emptiness. AuthorizationTupleDecoder accepts arbitrary yParity (0-255) and unconstrained r,s UInt256 values without validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker submits EIP-7702 SetCode transaction with malformed authorization: yParity=2 or r=secp256k1.n. This bypasses validation, reaches RecoverAddress which delegates to native secp256k1 library with out-of-range inputs, causing undefined behavior (crash, wrong address recovery, or signature malleability).
